task: Connect the two blue Cat5e cables from the old phone block to new keystone jacks, join them with a patch cord, then test the link.

titles: Identify the two blue Cat5e cables
Unscrew or release each cable from old block
Trim and strip the first Cat5e cable end
Seat wires into first keystone jack using T568B order
Repeat strip and punch-down for second cable
Snap both keystone jacks into a surface mount or patch panel
Connect the patch cord between the two jacks
Test the link with a cable tester

boxes.label: two blue Cat5e cables entering the distribution block
coax splitter (the silver metal box at the top)
coax cables (thick black cables with screw-on metal ends)
yellow-green wire at the bottom (ground wire — leave it alone)
